title: Caption-aware SplitClip and leave-gap TrimClip
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: SplitClip and ordinary TrimClip(ripple:false) now keep, rebind, or split-to-absolute captions and markers instead of refusing CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Media mutation stays on the existing generic and linked-audio paths; policy is applied after mutation in the same atomic command.

Split never auto-splits cue text and keeps the authored timeline range. A uniquely covered clipLocal or source cue rebinds to the remnant; a spanning clipLocal cue or marker becomes absolute at the same times; a spanning or uncovering source cue is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.

Leave-gap trim does not shift later content. The portion still on the host stays clipLocal at the same sequence times; the vacated gap keeps an absolute remnant with the same text (not cropped to empty as ripple close would). Absolute cues stay. Source uncover is ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. Linked AV members split and trim together; helpers run for every member id.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, adds a default clipLocal cue, splits at 30 frames, leave-gap trims 15 frames off the left out edge, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in.

TrimClip(ripple:true) / RippleTrimClip with captions still refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, including on the audio path (not rewritten as LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, caption-aware ripple trim, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
